title: MetBefore
description: Tracks players you've met on servers and notifies you when you encounter them again.
body:
Ever joined a server and wondered "Have I seen this person before?" MetBefore remembers for you.

The mod records every player you share a server with. The next time you meet them, a toast notification appears with their name, meet count, last seen date, and server.

## What you get
- **HUD notifications** - toast with the player's head, name, meet count, and server pops up when you see someone you've met before
- **Player history** - searchable list of every player you've encountered, with sorting and filters (press **L** to open)
- **Player details** - full info per player: timestamps, servers, meet history timeline, and personal notes
- **Bulk delete** - select multiple players and delete them at once
- **Watchlist** - choose to only get notified about specific players

## FAQ
**Does this work on servers?**
Yes - fully client-side, no server installation needed.

**What data is stored?**
Player names, UUIDs, skins, meet timestamps, and server addresses. Stored locally in `.minecraft/metbefore/players.json`.
